name: epochs / time-aware LR schedule
rationale: The cap stops training before a fixed-epoch cosine schedule finishes. A schedule that anneals to the GPU-minute cap would remove this confound when comparing backbones and learning rates.

name: seed_repeats_per_decision
rationale: Seed noise (sigma about 0.05 mIoU, seed repeat 0.3326 vs 0.3820) was larger than every knob effect I measured (|z| < 1). With 6-min runs a single run can't separate lr, decoder or weights effects. I'd like cheap multi-seed averaging or a shorter fixed-epoch proxy so I can run 2–3 seeds per arm.
